subject: gk
question: According to the Indian Constitution, which of the following is NOT a power of the Governor?

options.text: Vote during the no confidence motion

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vote during the no confidence motion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Governor**, as per the Indian Constitution, is the constitutional head of the state and does not participate in the voting during a **no-confidence motion**.
 
• A **no-confidence motion** is a parliamentary motion presented by the legislators questioning the confidence of the ruling government or its policies in the legislature.
 
• Such motions are debated and voted upon in the legislative assembly, where the elected representatives, not the Governor, decide the outcome.
 
• The Governor, being a constitutional authority, does not hold any legislative or executive voting rights in the assembly.
 
• The Governor's role is limited to ensuring the smooth functioning of the state legislature and exercising powers like summoning, proroguing, and dissolving the assembly as per constitutional provisions.
 
• Thus, the Governor cannot vote during a no-confidence motion, which is exclusively a function of the legislature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prorogue the state legislature**__

 __
 
• The Governor has the constitutional authority to **prorogue** the state legislature, which means discontinuing a session without dissolving it.
 
• This power is exercised as per **Article 174** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is used to manage legislative sessions and ensure smooth governance.
 
 
 
• **Summon the state legislature**__
 __
 
• The Governor has the power to **summon** the state legislature as per **Article 174** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• This involves convening the legislative assembly or council for conducting legislative business.
 
• Summoning is a critical function for initiating legislative processes.
 
 
 
• **Dissolve the state legislature**__
 
 
• The Governor can dissolve the state legislature, particularly the legislative assembly, as per **Article 174**, when necessary, such as in case of a failure to form a government.
 
• Dissolution ends the term of the assembly, leading to elections for a new legislature.
